correctness.rationale: For 0≤a≤c≤b≤1,b>0 the explicit unary/binary branching word has mechanical base density c with sparse length-k² insertions of b and a at N_k=2^{k^5}. The number of boundary crossings in any n-window is o(n); balanced-word discrepancy and arbitrarily long homogeneous patches establish extremal exponents a and b, hence descendant radii 2^{a/2},2^{b/2}. Total altered prefix is O((log n)^{3/5})=o(log n), so root B_n=2^{cn+o(log n)} and the radial point-eigenvalue series ∑|λ|^{2n}/B_n has exact OPEN disk of radius 2^{c/2}. Cauchy–Schwarz on descendants proves necessity even for nonradial eigenvectors. Infinitely many disjoint side subtrees furnish infinite eigenvalue multiplicity (b>0). The radial S* compression is a forward shift with weights sqrt(d_n); long b-to-a patches give normalized approximate eigenvectors for every radius between R_- and R_+, including endpoints, and a bounded explicit S right inverse with spectral radius 1/R_- plus ||S^n||²=K_n^+ excludes the complement. This proves exact annular non-surjectivity and full spectral disk. Independently checked rational mechanical-word counts, sample finite-tree radial recurrences and interval arithmetic, not astronomical sparse indices or infinite spectrums by sampling.
